articles.title: Five key takeaways from F1's big African Grand Prix reveal in Rwanda - Motorsport.com
articles.description: With the announcement of an African Grand Prix in the early 2030s, Formula 1 is finally set to head back to the African continent after a hiatus of over three decades. Motorsport.com was among the select media on the ground in Kigali to explore how the event …
articles.content: Tuesday's launch of the new African Grand Prix at Kigali's BK Arena in Rwanda was attended by Rwandan president Paul Kagame and both F1 boss Stefano Domenicali and FIA president Mohammed Ben Sulayem.… [+11927 chars]
